entities.summary: Danila Antsiferov was a notorious outlaw in 18th-century Tomsk, Russia, whose exploits have been documented in local folklore and historical records. Born in 1680, Antsiferov rose to notoriety for his cunning and bravery, earning him a place in the annals of regional history. His life and crimes were marked by a series of daring heists, thefts, and escapes, which captivated the imagination of locals and outsiders alike. Antsiferov's legend has endured, with many accounts of his exploits still recounted in hushed tones by local residents. The specifics of his crimes and personal life remain somewhat unclear, but his influence on the cultural narrative of the region is undeniable.
